blockers.blocker: ModuleRequest needs phase-aware identity and loading; ModuleSource/HostGetImportedModuleSource support is absent. Static module-shape and dynamic import-call lowering reject the phase explicitly. Removing these guards would evaluate an ordinary module instead of producing the required source value.

The native adapter rejects type=text. It needs a synthetic text default export, decoding policy and request-type cache identity so one resource imported as JSON/text has distinct records. Current fixture discovery and factories distinguish JavaScript and JSON only.

The adapter rejects type=bytes before binary fixture discovery. It needs binary-safe fixture bytes and hashes, a synthetic immutable byte default and request-type cache identity. Existing immutable ArrayBuffer machinery is present and should be reused.

Module requests and loading need a deferred phase, deferred namespace access must trigger evaluation, and cycle/top-level-await coordination must preserve deferred execution. Current namespace records expose eager-module bindings; removing the lowering guard would execute the graph too early.
